g.text: M6 real-proxy bridge: shared information and HF opportunities
Real ESM1v, original RF; 16 initial HF + all 256 LF; 45 subsequent HF purchases in every arm.
Top 1% recall; four known development pools, 256 candidates per assay, five paired seeds.
